about_blocks.text: Into Action Recovery Burnaby is the private residential program of Into Action Recovery Society, a men's addiction recovery organization founded in British Columbia in 2012. The house is at 6293 Marine Drive in south Burnaby, which is also the society's administrative office, a few minutes from Metrotown and its SkyTrain station.
about_blocks.html: Into Action Recovery Burnaby is the private residential program of Into Action Recovery Society, a men's addiction recovery organization founded in British Columbia in 2012. The house is at 6293 Marine Drive in south Burnaby, which is also the society's administrative office, a few minutes from Metrotown and its SkyTrain station.

about_blocks.text: Into Action positions Burnaby differently from its other houses. The centre describes it as smaller, with higher-end amenities and a more focused setting, and says staff know every client by name. The photos bear that out: a two-storey house on a treed lot, a bright renovated kitchen with a glass-door commercial fridge full of food, a home gym with a squat rack and bench, a carpeted program room with whiteboards and screens, and quiet bedrooms that look onto the trees.

about_blocks.text: Men choose a 30, 60 or 90-day stay. The day is built around individual counselling, group therapy and recovery work, with peers holding each other to the same standard. Into Action draws on CBT, DBT, SMART Recovery and the Twelve Steps, and recovery.com lists yoga, adventure outings, movie nights and off-site activities for this house. Men who complete the residential phase can move into Into Action's second-stage housing.

about_blocks.text: Like the society's other houses, Burnaby is a non-medical residence. There are no nurses or doctors on site, detox must be finished first, and residents keep their own mental health plan with their own prescriber or a virtual clinic Into Action works with. The centre is plain that it does not treat mental health conditions itself.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Into Action Recovery Burnaby

faqs.question: How is the Burnaby house different from Into Action's other locations?

answer_blocks.text: Burnaby is Into Action's private program. The centre says it has higher-end amenities, smaller capacity and smaller groups than its other houses, so there is more individual attention. The core program of counselling, groups and step work is the same.
answer_blocks.html: Burnaby is Into Action's private program. The centre says it has higher-end amenities, smaller capacity and smaller groups than its other houses, so there is more individual attention. The core program of counselling, groups and step work is the same.

faqs.question: How much does Into Action Recovery Burnaby cost?

answer_blocks.text: Into Action does not publish a price for Burnaby. It says the cost depends on whether you choose 30, 60 or 90 days, that admissions gives a transparent figure on the first call, and that it can help explore financing. Neither the centre nor recovery.com lists a dollar figure for this house.

faqs.question: How long is the program in Burnaby?

answer_blocks.text: You can stay 30, 60 or 90 days. The clinical team recommends a length during admission based on your history and goals, and Into Action says many men do better with a longer stay.

faqs.question: Where is Into Action Recovery Burnaby?

answer_blocks.text: It is at 6293 Marine Drive in south Burnaby, a few minutes from Metrotown SkyTrain station. Downtown Vancouver is about 25 minutes by car, New Westminster about 10, and Vancouver International Airport around 25 minutes for men flying in.

faqs.question: Is there medical care or detox at the Burnaby house?

answer_blocks.text: No. Into Action is not a medical facility and has no doctors or nurses on site. Detox has to be completed elsewhere before admission, and residents get medical and medication support through a partnered virtual provider or their own doctor.

faqs.question: Does the Burnaby program treat anxiety or depression?

answer_blocks.text: Into Action says it does not treat mental health conditions directly. recovery.com lists anger, anxiety, codependency and depression for this house, but the centre's own FAQ says it supports each man's existing mental health plan rather than providing that care itself.

faqs.question: What happens after the Burnaby program?

answer_blocks.text: Men can move into Into Action's second-stage housing for continued structure while they return to work or school. recovery.com also lists outpatient treatment, online aftercare, aftercare group therapy and alumni reunions for this location.

faqs.question: Why is the Burnaby program men only?

answer_blocks.text: Into Action has worked only with men since 2012. It says a men-only house removes social distractions and makes it easier to have direct, honest conversations and hold each other accountable.
